verdict.rationale: Stripe's official hosted MCP server lets AI agents read and write across most of the API (refunds, invoices, subscriptions, payment links, payouts and more). It adds analytics and report tools driven by documented natural-language prompts such as "What's my MRR for the last 6 months, by month?", and Stripe Projects is run by telling an agent what to set up, with human confirmation for risky writes. Missing for 10: a native in-Dashboard natural-language interface (natural-language operation depends on an external agent client connected via MCP or plugins), and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation in practice.
